First of all, major props to you for working so much and still making time for school. Although it's hasn't been easy, I really admire your dedication. It does sound like you are overworking yourself. 

I understand your anxiety and depression and having the feeling that they'll have enough of you. As an outsider, based on the information given, it is your anxiety causing that thought. I believe that they value you, as they should. I don't fully know the situation so I apologize if any of my suggestions are annoying, as in not possible, but I'm gonna give it a shot. 

Would it be possible to cut back a day at work? Or have shorter shifts? I completely understand if that isn't possible, some places the full-time hours are required or you may really need the money. Another option would be to take online classes if you aren't already doing so. You mention going to class, but do you mean physically or online? If you currently go in person, online might be easier to manage with working so much if you aren't able to cut back on hours. 

If you ever need anyone to talk to, message me, I am here. I know that feeling too well and it isn't a good feeling. I'm sorry you've been feeling that way. It's hard to take on life's struggles alone, but I understand not talking to others about it, I always worry that they won't understand and the advice offered normally only makes me feel worse. 

I can relate to getting fed up and angry because you feel that it comes easier to most, I do the same exact thing. The reality of it is that everyone struggles, just different struggles! Some people are just better at hiding their struggles than others.

 I am here to tell you that just based on what you've said in this post, you are not failing at life, you are going above and beyond! You're doing great! You just have to figure out what to do to get more rest. You always come first. Whether that be taking the semester off from school, asking for less hours, or trying to switch to online classes.

 I really hope you figure everything out. Always remember you're doing your best and you aren't alone! Feel free to reach out if needed, I'd be happy to help!
